identification: Original watercolour (possibly with gutta or masking resist giving the white outlines; she also paints on silk) of five whimsical stylised cats with flowers and a small bird on a purple-blue wash ground, signed 'Evelyn Antonysen' in white lower right. Image about 18 x 24 cm, gold slip, green mount, gilt rope-moulded frame with green marble-effect inner band, under glass. Evelyn Antonysen is a living North-West Tasmanian artist and art teacher (Forth, later Ulverstone; galleries in Penguin; Deloraine Craft Fair since 1996; Australian Society for Miniature Art committee). Her known work is mainly Tasmanian coastal landscapes; whimsical cats are not her usual line. She also sells reproductions and cards, so it may be a print. Current bid A$50, estimate 30-40.
